```yaml
name: Release Beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  release-beta:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: beta
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: master

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Create temporary beta branch
        run: |
          git fetch origin master
          git checkout -b beta-branch origin/master
          git push origin beta-branch

      - name: Run semantic-release
        run: npx semantic-release --branch beta-branch --tag beta

      - name: Delete temporary beta branch
        if: always()
        run: |
          git push origin --delete beta-branch
          git branch -D beta-branch
```
